name: covenant
description: The obligation layer for the open economy — a registry where a promise to pay is a first-class on-chain object, advanced only by cryptographic evidence.

scripts.test: forge test && npm run test:lens && npm run test:relay
scripts.demo: node --env-file-if-exists=.env lens/src/demo.js & npm --prefix app run dev
scripts.deploy: npm run preflight && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url cc3_testnet --broadcast --gas-estimate-multiplier 300 && npm run verify
scripts.deploy:probe: forge script script/ProveOne.s.sol:DeployProbe --rpc-url cc3_testnet --broadcast --gas-estimate-multiplier 300 && npm run verify
scripts.live: node --env-file-if-exists=.env lens/src/index.js & npm --prefix app run dev
